title.zh: 损失锥分数阶 Legendre 谱

summary: Compute the lowest ordered even angular eigenmodes with integer degrees retained and a regular initial-value solution.

identity.relation: Loss-cone pitch-cosine boundary and requested mode count to fractional Legendre angular eigenpairs
identity.direction: (xi_tp, mode_count, grid_points, backend) -> xi, degrees, eigenvalues, eigenfunctions, backend
identity.definition: Solve -[(1-xi^2)u′]′=lambda*u, u(0)=1, u′(0)=0, u(xi_tp)=0. Order roots through the continuous Sturm phase theta′=sqrt(lambda)[cos(theta)^2/(1-xi^2)+sin(theta)^2], theta(0)=pi/2, targeting theta(xi_tp)=(j+1)pi. Rayleigh bounds from p(xi)<=1 bracket each root. Evaluate u through an independent scaled linear initial-value equation; it is the regular even 2F1(-nu/2,(nu+1)/2;1/2;xi^2), lambda=nu(nu+1). Integer degrees are retained. There is no finite polynomial truncation.
identity.model: Regular self-adjoint Neumann/Dirichlet angular Sturm-Liouville problem; no distribution or kinetic evolution is solved.
identity.geometry: One-dimensional pitch-cosine interval from the symmetry endpoint xi=0 toward a loss-cone boundary at xi_tp
identity.coordinates: Dimensionless pitch cosine xi; eigenfunctions are columns in increasing eigenvalue order.
identity.boundary: u(0)=1, u′(0)=0 and a numerically checked endpoint residual |u(xi_tp)|<=2e-8. The returned grid includes zero and excludes xi_tp.
assumptions: The two legacy backend names are aliases for the same corrected method, not different approximation orders.

inputs.name: xi_tp
inputs.description: Loss-cone pitch-cosine endpoint where the angular mode is set to zero.
inputs.constraints: Converted with float; must satisfy 0 < xi_tp < 1.

inputs.name: mode_count
inputs.description: Number of lowest ordered modes, including any integer degree.
inputs.constraints: Positive integer value; booleans and fractional values are rejected.

inputs.name: grid_points
inputs.description: Requested number of pitch-cosine samples for returned eigenfunctions.
inputs.constraints: Integer value at least two; actual sample count is max(grid_points,mode_count+8).

inputs.name: backend
inputs.description: Legacy evaluator name retained for API calls.
inputs.constraints: Only 'truncated' and 'hypergeometric'; both use regular scaled initial-value evaluation and Sturm root ordering. No truncated series is used.

outputs.name: xi
outputs.description: Uniform pitch-cosine sample positions starting at the symmetry endpoint.
outputs.constraints: xi[i]=i*xi_tp/N_grid for i=0..N_grid-1; xi_tp itself is not sampled.

outputs.name: eigenvalues
outputs.description: Angular eigenvalue nu(nu+1) for each returned degree.
outputs.constraints: Positive and ordered with degrees for successful finite solves.

outputs.name: degrees
outputs.description: Nonnegative regular even-mode degree for each eigenvalue.
outputs.constraints: Ordered with the eigenvalues; integer degrees are preserved.

outputs.name: eigenfunctions
outputs.description: Angular mode samples, one column per degree.
outputs.constraints: First row is numerically normalized to one; no boundary row at xi_tp is returned.

outputs.name: backend
outputs.description: Requested legacy evaluator name; see evaluation_method for the actual numerical method.

outputs.name: evaluation_method
outputs.description: Actual common evaluator used by both legacy backend names.

outputs.name: boundary_residuals
outputs.description: Regular-mode values at the Dirichlet endpoint.
outputs.constraints: Absolute value at most 2e-8 on successful return.

preconditions: Finite interior xi_tp and valid integer counts.
supported: The lowest ordered angular modes, including integer degrees and small loss-cone intervals.
excluded: Physical population validation, transport, global equilibrium or an arbitrarily large mode-count performance guarantee.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: ValueError for invalid interval, counts or backend; native numeric conversion failures may propagate.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: RuntimeError or FloatingPointError if phase or regular-mode integration fails or returns nonfinite values.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: RuntimeError if an independently evaluated endpoint residual exceeds 2e-8; no incomplete eigenpair set is returned.

example.description: Recover the exact lowest integer mode at xi_tp=1/sqrt(3).
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.kinetic.loss_cone_spectrum import solve_loss_cone_spectrum
r=solve_loss_cone_spectrum(1/np.sqrt(3),2,grid_points=40)
np.testing.assert_allclose(r['eigenvalues'][0],6.,rtol=1e-10)
np.testing.assert_allclose(r['eigenfunctions'][:,0],1-3*r['xi']**2,atol=2e-10)
assert np.max(np.abs(r['boundary_residuals']))<2e-8
example.expected: The lowest eigenvalue is 6 with normalized eigenfunction 1-3*xi^2; no integer-root omission.

scope: Integer-mode failure regression for both legacy backend names.
Independent linear shooting and 60-digit hypergeometric endpoint checks across xi_tp=1e-4 to 0.9999, up to fourteen modes.
Normalized orthogonality and independent finite-volume mesh refinement.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Analytic identities, explicit failure regressions and independent numerical comparisons establish the stated mathematical contract. They do not establish measured-plasma validity or a general stability theorem.
known_limitations: Numerical residual checks are finite precision; the endpoint xi_tp=1 is excluded by the singular differential operator.
The legacy backend names no longer request a truncated approximation.
